ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Riimba
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Riimba is a semi-autonomous cleaning drone. It is not an independent mechanoid: it is a dumb chassis driven by a control station, and it only works inside that station's broadcast radius.
Gestate Riimba units at a mech gestator like any other light mech - they take steel and components, no subcore of their own. The brain lives in the control station instead, which needs a basic subcore to build. One station drives up to three units within ten tiles, charges them at its docking bays, and takes their collected waste.
A working Riimba fills up. Ordinary dirt, ash and sludge pack down into recyclable trash; blood, vomit and other bodily fluids are sealed into wastepacks instead. A unit returns to its station when its bin is full or its charge runs low, and the station puts the waste out on its output spot for a hauler.
Requires Biotech (mech gestator, subcores) and Vanilla Recycling Expanded (trash).
